title: Yellow Gooey American Vialone Nano Grill
description: A funky American dish featuring vialone nano rice, grilled to perfection with a dairy free sauce, this recipe is perfect for those looking to show off their culinary skills.
instructions: Preheat the yakimono grill to medium high heat.
In a large bowl, mix together the vialone nano rice, non dairy butter, olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper until well combined.
Add the vegan cheddar shreds, canned corn kernels, and diced bell peppers to the bowl and stir until the cheese is evenly distributed.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the rice mixture onto the preheated grill.
Grill the rice mixture for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until it is golden brown and crispy.
Repeat the grilling process with the remaining rice mixture.
Serve the yellow gooey American vialone nano grill hot and enjoy.
Garnish with diced scallions and a side of your favorite dipping sauce.
